summary: United Microelectronics Corp (UMC) filed a Form 6-K disclosing the disposal of 1,174,694 common shares of Novatek Microelectronics Corp through conversion of zero-coupon exchangeable bonds due 2026. The shares were converted at an average price of NT$479.8 per share, totaling NT$563,618,180, generating a gain of NT$386,963,843 (impacting retained earnings, not net income). This reduces UMC's Novatek stake to 2.51%. No board resolution is noted. The transaction was executed per the offering memorandum. As a capital return via bond conversion, watch for further dilution or remaining bond overhang.
